what: Spot measurements made on a Meta Quest 3S in the Quest Browser during the first headset sessions, on 5 November 2026, and written into the build log the same day. They were taken over the Chrome DevTools Protocol while the wearer used the app; the builds were those of that day, not the one submitted.

frame_rate.method: requestAnimationFrame timing in the running immersive session (tmp/quest-check.py fps)

two_pieces_carried.note: before the key light's six-pass shadow was moved to alternate frames

hit_test_without_room_scan.method: a probe evaluated inside the running session (tmp/q-hit2.js), in a room with no Space Setup
